name: Furlong
description: Farmland seen from the air: furrowed plots of four crops, the furrows running across or along each field as a smooth field decides.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --n: @rn(-0.5, 1.5, 1.5); --m: @rn(-0.5, 1.5, 2); background: @match($(m) < 0.25, @p(var(--color1)), $(m) < 0.45, @p(var(--color2)), $(m) < 0.62, @p(var(--color3)), $(m) < 0.8, @p(var(--color4)), @p(var(--color5))); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 17%, transparent 17% 25%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 17%, transparent 17% 25%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@calc(floor($(n) * 3) % 2 * 90)deg); transform: rotate(@calc(floor($(n) * 3) % 2 * 90)deg); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
